answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor each identity to a costly, verifiable stake: require every agent to lock a small bond in an onyx-hard ledger and prove a unique hardware-backed vertex key before it can trade. Reputation then flows like a river — payments and attestations from long-lived, well-bonded agents carry more weight than new ones, so spawning thousands of sock-puppets costs real money while earning almost nothing, because a fresh identity with no history has no downstream flow to spend.
